uplink._note: byte0 0x11 -> endpoint ((0x11 & 0xE0) >> 5) | ((0x11 & 0x06) << 2) = 0. One ZCL standard report carries one endpoint, so the frame yields a single channels[] entry labelled endpoint0 (upstream labels this sample temperature<endpoint + 1> = temperature1).
